latestVersion.changelog:
Add Music to AI Video — v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Add background music to AI-generated silent videos; supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB.
- Cloud-based processing returns 1080p MP4 videos in 20–40 seconds.
- Automatic token and session management for quick setup.
- Simple user commands: upload, edit, check credits, export, and download.
- Error handling and usage tips included for a smooth experience.
